referenceFunction.generalComment: The multioutput-process "cotton production" delivers the co-products "cotton fibres, ginned, at farm", "cotton seed, at farm". The allocation is based on economic criteria and on mass balance. World production of ginned cotton was 26.2 Mt in 2005. The inventory refers to 1 kg dry fibres and 1.77 kg seed from standard China production.; UUID: 4e1dc5c9-832f-3030-8410-143fd7488787
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventories include the cultivation of cotton upon Chinese standards. Included steps are soil cultivation, pestizides fertilisation (mineral fertilizer), harvest, loading for transport and extraction of the fibres in a gin plant
referenceFunction.name: Cotton fibres, ginned, at farm

geography.text: Data mainly from expert gremiums of respective country

technology.text: Cultivation of cotton upon Chinese conventional production standards

representativeness.productionVolume: World production of cotton fibres was 26.2 Mt in 2005.
